title: (50X) Autonomously folding a pile of 5 previously-unseen towels
summary: A Berkeley PR2 robot autonomously folds a pile of five previously unseen towels, shown at 50x speed. The video accompanies a 2010 ICRA paper from Pieter Abbeel's group.
why: HN cites it as the benchmark for how hard and slow robot laundry folding was, in threads about household robots and AI progress.

quote.text: Here's the same guy (PR2) in action 7 years ago folding towels at 50x speed
